queries.query: Windsor Ontario official GIS parcel map land registry ArcGIS REST
queries.result: Official City of Windsor mapping pages and the City open-data catalogue identify a public parcel dataset maintained by the Geomatics GIS team. The current ArcGIS item resolves to the public PropertyParcels MapServer layer.

queries.query: Windsor Ontario carte SIG parcelles cadastre officiel
queries.result: French-language discovery returned the bilingual/translated City/CUDC parcel catalogue entry and an Ontario land-registry overview, but no separate French-only City parcel endpoint. The same public City parcel service was then checked directly.

researchNote: A public City of Windsor parcel layer was identified and queried anonymously. The exact WUP point was preserved and returned one intersecting polygon. This packet is source research only, not source integration or runtime admission.
